scope.monitorRead.message: blocklist, Postmaster, SNDS and DMARC data
scope.monitorRead.note: what the monitor:read scope is used for, after the scope's key in Settings › Integrations

scope.alertsRead.note: what the alerts:read scope is used for

scope.assetsWrite.message: add domains and IPs to monitoring
scope.assetsWrite.note: what the assets:write scope is used for

unreachable.message: Couldn't reach {host} ({reason, select, timeout_s {timeout after {n} s} timeout_ms {timeout after {n} ms} timeout {timeout} refused {connection refused} dns {DNS lookup failed} token {token refresh failed} http {HTTP {status}} other {network error}}, {attempts, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}})
unreachable.note: HostRepute couldn't be reached; host: api.hostrepute.com; shown in Deliverability and Settings › Integrations

syncFailed.note: error: what went wrong, in English

problem.unavailable.message: {reach}. {nothing, select, saved {Nothing was saved; try again in a minute.} changed {Nothing changed; try again in a minute.} other {Nothing was requested; try again in a minute.}}
problem.unavailable.note: reach: why HostRepute couldn't be reached, already written in the reader's language

problem.keyFormat: Paste the whole key, without spaces. It starts with hr_live_.

problem.answeredError.message: HostRepute answered with an error ({error}). Nothing was saved.

problem.keyRejected.message: HostRepute didn't accept this key. Copy it again from HostRepute → Settings → API; it needs the monitor:read, alerts:read and assets:write scopes.
problem.keyRejected.note: HostRepute → Settings → API is HostRepute's own menu, in English; the scopes are keys, never translated

problem.notConnected: HostRepute isn't connected. Connect it first in Settings › Integrations.

problem.reconnect.message: HostRepute rejected the token{when, select, yes { on {date}} other {}}. Reconnect HostRepute, then try again.
problem.reconnect.note: date: the day HostRepute rejected it (Oct 2)

problem.noAssetsScope: This connection doesn't have the assets:write scope, so ReputeCast can't add to monitoring. Reconnect HostRepute and approve it.
problem.notCandidate: Only this workspace's sending domains, dedicated IPs and server hostnames can be added to monitoring.

problem.limit.message: Your HostRepute team “{team}” monitors {used, number} of {limit, number} assets allowed by its plan, so {asset} can't be added right now. This is a HostRepute limit, not a ReputeCast one.
problem.limit.note: team: the HostRepute team's name; asset: a domain or IP

notify.reconnectTitle.note: a notification to members who manage the HostRepute connection

notify.reconnectBody: HostRepute rejected the token. Blocklist, Postmaster, SNDS and DMARC data is stale until someone reconnects; Send Readiness marks the reputation check as unknown.
